mapper.select: select u.dates, u.id user_id, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, IFNULL(uv.pvn, 'unknown') version, u.create_time from ods_user u LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, uv.pvn FROM (SELECT user_id, MIN(create_time) AS min_create_time FROM ods_user_version GROUP BY user_id) min_uv INNER JOIN ods_user_version uv ON min_uv.user_id = uv.user_id AND min_uv.min_create_time = uv.create_time) uv ON u.id = uv.user_id LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) where u.dates = #{dates} limit #{rows} offset #{startRows}
